properties.name: Settling a decision records which option won, without rewriting the deliberation that produced it
properties.statement: Promoted 2026-09-20 on Anthony's word. flo2 settled two decisions correctly and both kept reading 'OPEN — is …?' with bodies ending 'Options, none chosen.' An accepted decision that still reads as an open question is worse than an unsettled one, because a later reader trusts the prose over the status. The only route today is resending the whole node — the very operation measured to lose content. A short free-text field on the setter lets the settling act say what it settled.
